about: Fixed labeled corpus for recall-eval.spec.ts. Change it only deliberately: metrics are comparable across retrieval changes only on the same corpus. 'owner' writes the personal and shared memories; 'outsider' is another user whose decoys share keywords and must never be returned. A memory with 'occurred_at' is written with that date; a query with 'time_range' passes it to recall (the dated cases).
